// why this file exists: pyright ran with no configuration and reported 431 diagnostics, so the
type-check job was permanently red and could not signal a new problem.
81 of those were reportMissingImports for FIRST-PARTY modules that live
in chop_shop/ and are imported by bare name, because the entry points
insert that directory into sys.path at runtime. That is the same
deliberate pattern the E402 per-file-ignores in ruff.toml document.
pyright cannot see a runtime sys.path mutation, so it needs extraPaths.
Third-party stubs come from the project venv via venvPath/venv.
// deliberately relaxed: reportMissingImports stays on — it catches real typos.
The rules below are switched off with reasons; see the PR for counts.
Optional-access rules fire heavily against pyrekordbox and mutagen,
whose attributes are dynamically typed, and against SQLAlchemy row
objects. Those are library-shape problems, not defects in this code.
// conditional imports: These are resolved at runtime or are genuinely optional, and pyright
cannot see them: FableGear.config only exists when the app is installed
as a package (cli.py tries it and falls back), _version is generated at
build time, hid and mcp.server.fastmcp are optional dependencies.
